blind.B1: No. The paper (PMC7475200) is a VDR gain-of-function study: rat tibialis anterior electrotransfer, VDR-OE (right) vs empty vector (left) (S2.2, S3.1). No rat is exercised. The only exercise factor is human 20-wk resistance training, microarray GSE47881 (S2.8.p1, S3.4), used for VDR correlations. No sequenced sample in GSE110507 carries an exercise factor.
blind.B2: VDR-OE vs contralateral empty-vector control, n = 7 rats per arm (S2.7.p1, FIG5 legend n = 7, S3.2.p1). Metadata also hold a VDR knock-down arm (shRNA vs scramble, 7 animals) that the paper does not report.
blind.B3: Yes. Each animal gives two limbs (right treated, left control): 14 animals x 2 = 28 samples in metadata; fields 'animal identifier' / 'subject' (416-429) identify the animal. S2.7.p1: design matrices account for biological pairing between treated and control limbs. Packet A expression check says not_supported (r 0.084, p 0.26), but the paper states the pairing, so the key is documented.
blind.B4: One edgeR glmFit with a design matrix accounting for limb pairing (S2.7.p1: 'Differential expression was analysed using the glmFit function of edgeR with design matrices to account for biological pairing'). Paper does not say whether the KI arm was fitted alone or jointly with KD.
blind.B5: S3.2.p1: 'altered expression of 3,330 genes (P < 0.05)'; FIG5A 'p < 0.05'; raw p, no fold-change cutoff for DEGs (log-fold changes </> 0.26 used only for pathway-node mapping in S2.7.p1); 310 gene-sets at FDR < 5%. Prior filter: CPM at count 10, TMM.

checks.evidence: No exercise arm in GSE110507 (S2.2, S3.1; metadata vdr status = Sham/IVE knock-in/knock-out). Exercise exists only in GSE47881 (S2.8.p1, accession mention list).
Refused at design; no contrast fitted. Ownership note (14 KI samples, animals 416-422, n = 7) matches S2.7.p1/FIG5 n = 7.

No DE run. Pairing by animal is documented in S2.7.p1 and recorded as repeated_measure_unit = animal in paper_reconstruction. Mechanical flags (unused_subject_like_column, pairing_key_candidate) are moot because the case stopped before modelling; pairing_check 'not_supported' is not a reason to doubt the key given the paper's statement.
No fit. paper_method (edgeR, CPM filter, TMM, paired glmFit) is transcribed correctly from S2.7.p1.
Single sex (male Wistar), limbs of one animal; nothing to alias with exercise since no exercise factor.
Integer fraction 1.0, max 3.17e6, GEO description raw counts, paper used Rsubread featureCounts; raw counts -> edgeR is consistent.
paper_threshold pvalue 0.05, no effect cutoff, locator S3.2.p1: matches B5 verbatim; FDR 5% correctly attributed to gene-sets only.
HANDBACK reports no DEG numbers of its own ('Ours: none'), cites paper's 3,330 at P<0.05 and 310 gene-sets correctly; makes no overclaim.

Reason 'no exercise arm' is true and established by a wide check: paper full text (rat experiments contain no exercise), the whole metadata (4 groups all Sham/IVE electrotransfer), and the exercise cohort traced to GSE47881. Not a narrow search.

human_items: Open policy: whether a VDR-OE vs control run is wanted as a non-exercise sensitivity/reference result (paired edgeR, P<0.05, paper 3,330 genes). Not required: the case is correctly refused for the exercise question. The paper's exercise data (GSE47881 human RET microarray) would need a separate case.
summary: 该系列(GSE110507)是大鼠胫骨前肌VDR过表达/敲低实验,所有样本均未运动,论文中的运动部分只在人类数据集GSE47881中,因此在设计阶段拒绝运动对比是正确的,拒绝理由属实且检查范围足够。论文方法(edgeR、CPM过滤、TMM、按动物配对、P<0.05)和归属判断均记录准确,没有发现阻断性或主要问题。
